description: This file is a test script for verifying git configuration behaviors using a testing framework. It sets up various scenarios to check how git config handles defaults, presence of config entries, type parsing, and error conditions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution and output matching.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to fail, validating error handling.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks if a pattern exists in a file.
